Title: PackageQueryOptions Model
Summary: Options for filtering packages when querying from a plugin server.
Content:
# PackageQueryOptions Model

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Models`

## Purpose
Filter options when querying packages from a plugin distribution server.

## Properties

### Os
```csharp
public string? Os { get; set; }
```
Target operating system filter.

**Supported values:**
- `"win"` - Windows
- `"mac"` - macOS
- `"linux"` - Linux
- `"android"` - Android

### Arch
```csharp
public string? Arch { get; set; }
```
Target architecture filter.

**Supported values:**
- `"x64"` - 64-bit x86
- `"arm64"` - 64-bit ARM
- `"x86"` - 32-bit x86
- `"armv7"` - 32-bit ARM v7

### Version
```csharp
public string? Version { get; set; }
```
Specific version to retrieve (used for downloads).

## Example

```csharp
var options = new PackageQueryOptions
{
    Os = "win",
    Arch = "x64"
};

var packages = await pluginPackageService.GetPackagesAsync(
    server, "my-app", options);

// Download specific version
var downloadOptions = new PackageQueryOptions
{
    Os = "win",
    Arch = "x64",
    Version = "1.2.3"
};

var download = await pluginPackageService.DownloadPackageAsync(
    server, "my-app", "my-plugin", downloadOptions);
```

## See Also
- `IPluginPackageService` methods accept these options
- `Package` model for results
